# The news matcher's fixture (tests/test_news.py). Every line is a SYNTHETIC headline written for
# this test, never copied coverage, in the shape "Headline - Outlet => slug, slug" or "=> -" for
# a line that must match nothing. Shapes come from the first real dry run (2026-10-20).

# Plain names, any case, hyphens and possessives
Study links afternoon caffeine to shorter sleep in teens - Example News => caffeine
Caffeine-free sodas gain shelf space - Example News => caffeine
Melatonin's effect on jet lag tested in new trial - Example News => melatonin
CREATINE MAY HELP OLDER ADULTS KEEP MUSCLE, REVIEW SAYS - Example News => creatine
Two charged after fentanyl seizure at border crossing - Example News => fentanyl
Regulators review aspartame safety data again - Example News => aspartame
State weighs limits on nicotine pouches - Example News => nicotine

# Brands, aliases and curated news names
Recall hits Aleve and Claritin tablets over labeling error - Example News => loratadine, naproxen
Tylenol maker loses appeal in lawsuit - Example News => acetaminophen
Can you take Advil after a flu shot? Doctors explain - Example News => ibuprofen
Ozempic and Mounjaro prescriptions climb among older adults - Example News => semaglutide, tirzepatide
Schools move to drop Red 40 dye from cafeteria snacks - Example News => allura-red-ac

Baby bottles without BPA now the norm, survey finds - Example News => bisphenol-a
CBD gummies recalled over labeling - Example News => cannabidiol
# DHA names three catalogue molecules (DHEA, dihydroxyacetone, docosahexaenoic acid): none.
